s: There was once a devout man of the Children of Israel, whose family span cotton-thread; and he used every day to sell the yarn and buy fresh cotton, and with the profit he laid in daily bread for his household.

One morning he went out and sold the day’s yarn as wont, when there met him one of his brethren, who complained to him of need; so he gave him the price of the thread and returned, empty-handed, to his family, who said to him, “Where is the cotton and the food?”
Quoth he, “Such an one met me and complained to me of want; whereupon I gave him the price of the yarn.”
And they said, “How shall we do?
Now they had a cracked trencher and a jar; so he took them to the bazar but none would buy them of him.
However presently, as he stood in the market, there passed by a man with a fish,—And Shahrazad perceived the dawn of day and ceased saying her permitted say.
